title: Abstract Painting
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: A rectangular canvas is divided into unit squares, and every edge of every square must be painted red, green or blue. A painting is good when each square uses exactly two of the three colours on its four edges, each colour on exactly two of them. The task is to count good paintings modulo one billion and seven, for grids of up to fourteen rows and two thousand columns.
